title: RFC7: add support for validator plugins
reason: This PR adds a new user-facing validator plugin feature with a new configuration option (`validator` in provider definitions) and changes the `ProviderInvalidQueryError` OGC exception code, both of which should be reflected in the static documentation.

title: Improve CRS support in OAMaps
reason: The PR changes how CRS values are parsed and normalized (replacing the CRS_CODES mapping with new get_uri/get_curie functions), which alters the accepted input formats and behavior for the public map query API, so the documentation describing CRS handling should be updated.

title: Pooling
reason: The PR adds new user-facing configuration options (pool_size, max_overflow, pool_recycle, pool_timeout, pool_pre_ping) for SQL providers that should be documented in the static docs.

title: STAC and OAProc fixes
reason: The PR adds a new public configuration option `allow_internal_requests` for processes and changes how internal HTTP requests are handled (SSRF protection), which should be documented in the user-facing configuration docs.

title: Updates to the OGC API - Maps Support
reason: The PR changes the default CRS handling for OGC API Maps (now using CRS84 and storage_crs), adds a new CRS code, and modifies the WMS facade provider's query signature by removing the bbox_crs parameter, which are user-facing behavior changes that should be reflected in the documentation.

title: Fix CRS support on WMS Facade
reason: The PR changes how the 'crs' and 'bbox-crs' query parameters are interpreted (now accepting EPSG codes and URIs via a new mapping), which is user-visible behavior that should be reflected in the documentation.

title: rename base_edr instance functions (#2298)
reason: The PR renames public methods `get_instances` and `get_instance` to `instances` and `instance` on the `BaseEDRProvider` class, which is part of the public API surface for provider developers, so the documentation describing these methods must be updated.

title: Parquet batch configuration and documentation for spec updates
reason: The PR adds new user-facing configuration options (batch_size and batch_readahead) to the Parquet provider, which should be documented in the static docs.

title: OAProc: derive jobControlOptions and outputTransmission from plugin (#2257)
reason: This PR adds new user-facing configuration options (jobControlOptions and outputTransmission) that can be set in plugin metadata, changing how users configure process descriptions, which should be documented.

title: add resolution/default to collection extents.temporal configuration (#2260)
reason: The PR adds new user-facing configuration options (resolution and default) for collection extents.temporal, which are exposed in the API output and should be documented in the static docs.

title: PubSub: add support for Kafka (#2259)
reason: The PR adds a new user-facing Kafka pubsub client option and changes the constructor signature of existing HTTP and MQTT clients from broker_url to publisher_def, which are public API changes that should be reflected in the documentation.

title: Support SQL connection string
reason: The PR adds support for SQL connection strings, a new user-facing configuration option that changes how the connection parameter is interpreted, which should be documented.

title: add support for OGC API Publish-Subscribe Workflow - Part 1: Core (#2146)
reason: This PR adds a new user-facing Pub/Sub feature with new configuration options (pubsub section), a new /asyncapi endpoint, and new CLI command, all of which require documentation updates in docs/source.

title: Implement optional count in Feature Providers
reason: The PR adds a new user-facing `count` configuration option that changes the default behavior of providers (numberMatched is now optional), which should be documented in the static docs.

title: update EDR and Maps to support MetOcean access and visualization workflows (#2213)
reason: The PR adds new user-facing features (subset and properties parameters for maps, corridor query parameters for EDR, custom dimension configuration in the schema) and changes documented behavior (e.g., EDR instance handling, OGC reltype URLs, new config options), requiring updates to the static documentation.

title: fix: add fix for slow full count in postgresql
reason: The PR adds a new public configuration option 'count' to the provider definition (with a default of True) that changes how numberMatched is reported, which is user-facing behavior that should be documented.

title: Add CRS parameter support to EDR API

title: Fix WMTSFacade provider
